sourceDescription: Troop silhouettes reconstructed with the built-in image generation tool from user-supplied fantasy character and machine references. Source authorship and publication were not independently verified.

approval.scope: Publish the 109 accepted bitmap proposals. The three rejected machines are excluded.
approval.evidence: all are accepted, add them to prod

preparation.bitmapStage: Each subject was rebuilt as a separate high-resolution bitmap and approved in the local artwork review. The Atreides and Harkonnen troops established the silhouette style.
preparation.mask: For dark foregrounds, alpha multiplied by inverse luminance preserves opaque white cutouts. The light Grizzly And Son bitmap uses alpha directly. Gaussian sigma 0.65 pixels, threshold 0.5, minimum component area 12 pixels.
preparation.trace: Potrace 1.16, turdsize 12, alphamax 1.0, opttolerance 0.4. SVG authoring assigns the root ID and stamp, uniformly normalizes to a 100 by 100 viewBox and applies the troop optimization profile.
preparation.paint: Monochrome geometry inherits caller paint; structural gaps are transparent.
preparation.collection: The existing Troops category supplies catalogue and picker membership.
